title: Installment Payment Plans — Renewal Billing, Premium Posting and Rounding Standards
content:
Rounding: every billed amount on the **Installment Payment Plans** is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up. This and the following billing operations standards are the same on all six Cardinal Point plans.

| Standard | Paid-in-Full | Two-Pay | Four-Pay | Six-Pay Direct Bill | Monthly EFT | Monthly Card Autopay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Renewal down payment due | expiration date of the expiring term | same | same | same | same | same |
| Renewal down payment drafted automatically on its due date | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Posting of policy premium transactions | each transaction posted once, same amount, same day | same | same | same | same | same |
| Rounding of billed amounts | nearest cent, half up | same | same | same | same | same |

**Rounding examples (hypothetical amounts).** An amount worked out as 41.625 is billed as 41.63; 41.624 is billed as 41.62.

**Premium posting.** A policy premium transaction is posted to the plan once, for the same amount and on the same day as the policy transaction is processed.

**Renewal.** The renewal down payment falls due on the expiration date of the expiring term on every plan; on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan and the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan it is drafted automatically on that date.
